verdict.rationale: Docs confirm SIP trunking support—assistants can be dialed/received via any SIP client or softphone (BYO SIP URI), which suggests custom carrier/PBX connectivity, but there's no explicit documentation of importing existing Twilio/Telnyx numbers or configuring arbitrary external carrier trunks beyond the basic SIP URI dial-in/out flow. missing for 10: explicit number-porting/import workflow for Twilio/Telnyx, detailed carrier trunk configuration docs, independent confirmation of BYO-carrier setups working in production.
